definitions.explanation: The property of inhibiting or preventing the growth of bacteria. Widely used in product descriptions for treated materials and surfaces.

examples.japanese: {抗菌|こうきん}⟦{加工|かこう}→加工：11793_kakou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It has been given antibacterial treatment.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦まな{板|いた}→まな板：04977_manaita⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{抗菌|こうきん}⟦{仕様|しよう}→仕様：00472_shiyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{衛生的|えいせいてき}→衛生的：27737_eiseiteki⟧だ。
examples.english: This cutting board has antibacterial specifications and is hygienic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{抗菌|こうきん}・⟦{消臭|しょうしゅう}→消臭：21552_shoushuu⟧⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついた⟦{靴下|くつした}→靴下：00726_kutsushita⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧だ。
examples.english: Recently, socks with antibacterial and deodorizing functions have become popular.

notes:
Composed of {抗|こう} (anti-, resist) and ⟦{菌|きん}→菌：02682_kin⟧ (bacteria, germs). Very common on product labels in Japan, especially for household items.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {抗菌|こうきん}⟦{加工|かこう}→加工：11793_kakou⟧: antibacterial treatment/finish
- {抗菌|こうきん}⟦{仕様|しよう}→仕様：00472_shiyou⟧: antibacterial specification
- {抗菌|こうきん}⟦{作用|さよう}→作用：05761_sayou⟧: antibacterial action
- {抗菌|こうきん}⟦{剤|ざい}→〜剤：30790_zai⟧/{抗菌|こうきん}{薬|やく}: antibacterial agent/drug
- {抗菌|こうきん}・{防臭|ぼうしゅう}: antibacterial and deodorant

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {抗菌|こうきん}: antibacterial — inhibiting bacterial growth
- ⟦{殺菌|さっきん}→殺菌：09781_sakkin⟧: sterilization — killing bacteria
- ⟦{除菌|じょきん}→除菌：07789_jokin⟧: sanitizing — removing bacteria
- ⟦{滅菌|めっきん}→滅菌：24175_mekkin⟧: sterilization — completely destroying all microorganisms (medical/lab use)
- ⟦{消毒|しょうどく}→消毒：07591_shoudoku⟧: disinfection — eliminating pathogens

USAGE:
Japan has a strong market for {抗菌|こうきん} products. The term appears on everything from phone cases and keyboards to socks, towels, and cutting boards.
